messages:
maria-hr: Quick Q for managers: if we want a promotion + comp change to take effect on 2026-08-01, when's the absolute last day to submit packets?

ken-engineer: Curious too 1 we have someone who started ramping in March and looks ready.

ada-manager: Last cycle I thought it was the 10th of the prior month?

maria-hr: Correct 1 operational rule: packets must be marked "ready for review" and submitted with manager sign-off by 2026-07-12 EOD PT to hit 08/01 payroll. That includes comp approvals and leveling sign-offs.

recruiting-bot: [automated] Reminder: comp committee meeting scheduled 2026-07-20. Packets submitted by 2026-07-12 will be considered for August effective dates.

ken-engineer: If the leveling panel clears earlier but comp is late, do we still get a title change on org chart?

maria-hr: Yes 1 leveling updates propagate once the leveling approval is complete. Salary updates wait for comp committee and payroll feeds. Managers will see the new level in People Ops the day the panel approves.

ada-manager: One scenario 1 internal candidate is promoted but we want to do a smaller salary increase now and larger adjustment at year-end. Is staggered comp allowed?

comp-squad: Staggered adjustments are allowed but need clear justification and a timeline in the packet. Also include the expected business reason (budget/phased uplift). Both changes need their own comp entries. Retro rules still apply for effective dates.

maria-hr: Related: if approvals occur after payroll cutoff, payroll will auto-retro for up to 30 days. Beyond 30 days requires exec sign-off.

ken-engineer: What about spot/one-time bonuses instead of salary? Faster?

comp-squad: Spot bonuses are evaluated separately. They typically have a 10 business day turnaround once manager submits the Spot Bonus form and comp-partner signs off. Not taxable differently, but they avoid band/top limits.

ada-manager: For the packet, what docs are must-haves? We lost time last cycle with missing info.

maria-hr: Must-haves: 1) Promotion Request form link (internal), 2) Manager justification headline + 3 bullets, 3) two recent peer/skip-level feedback snippets, 4) sample deliverables (links to PRs or projects), 5) proposed comp and band reference, 6) note if >15% uplift so comp knows to expect exception.

ken-engineer: If proposed comp exceeds band top, what's the approval path?

comp-squad: Exceeding band top requires market comps (two external sources), business justification, and VP-level approval. Add those attachments; comp-system will auto-escalate.

ada-manager: How do we handle conversions from contractor -> FTE plus promotion? Same forms?

maria-hr: Use the Convert Request form plus a Promotion Request if level differs from conversion baseline. Recruiting should attach candidate record and background check status. Conversions that change level still go to comp committee.

ken-engineer: If an employee disputes the level managers proposed, what's the appeals path?

maria-hr: Escalation: 1) Document evidence in packet, 2) L4 review panel (cross-functional senior ICs) examines, 3) People Ops mediates. Keep evidence concise: metric + example + timeframe.

ada-manager: Any tips for writing the 3-bullet justification? Managers always make them vague.

comp-squad: Use the structure: headline, 1) changed responsibilities, 2) clear impact (metrics/% improvement or revenue/savings), 3) peer calibration (how this person exceeds typical expectations for current level). Put a one-line summary at top.

maria-hr: Also add any upcoming risk (counteroffer risk, retention note) if timing is urgent 1 comp partners prioritize those marked urgent.

recruiting-bot: [automated] Note: For conversions, Recruiting must set HC Type = "Contractor->FTE" to ensure headcount reconciliation.

ken-engineer: Last: when does manager get notified that comp is finalized?

maria-hr: Managers receive an automated notification the day comp-partner updates the packet post committee. Payroll receives finalized feeds same day for processing. Expect manager notif within 3 business days of committee sign-off in most cases.

ada-manager: Thanks everyone 1 I'll bundle the samples and submit before 07/12.

comp-squad: Good plan 1 ping us for a quick packet review if you want early feedback.
